name: Architecture (Arts Subdomain)
body:
Associated Domain: Artifice

Replacement Power: The following granted power replaces the dancing weapon power of the Artifice domain.

Secret Passage (Sp)

At 8th level, you can create a temporary passage through walls and other obstacles, as passwall, that lasts for a number of rounds equal to your cleric level. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every four levels beyond 8th.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st—expeditious construction, 8th—secret vault, 9th—resplendent mansion.
